commit.message:
Fix encoding of SSH certs with critical options (#9208)

* Add tests for issue #9207

* Fix encoding of SSH certs with critical options

* Test unexpected additional values for crit opts/exts

structuredContent.title:
Fix encoding of SSH certs with critical options (#9208)

* Add tests for issue #9207

* Fix encoding of SSH certs with critical options

* Test unexpected additional values for crit opts/exts
